home.description: The hub for independent developers to make themselves known and upload their projects.

about.description: We are a group of university developers looking to help other small development teams.

knowledge.giuliano: Knowledge of C++, Python, and Lua.
knowledge.johnny: Knowledge of C++, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

goals.title: Goals
goals.goal2: Allow users to share their projects and work in which they participated.
goals.goal3: Helping small developers get involved in new projects.

reviews.title: What our users say
reviews.description: Hear directly from developers and gamers who are part of the IndieNest community.

review1.quote: IndieNest finally gave my small project the visibility it needed. Connecting with other devs here has been invaluable!
review1.author: Alex Chen

review2.quote: As a gamer, finding unique indie titles is tough. IndieNest makes discovering hidden gems easy and fun.
review2.author: Maria Garcia

review3.quote: The feedback and collaboration tools are fantastic. Found my composer and lead artist for my current game right here.
review3.author: Sam 'Driftwood' Kay

review4.quote: A much-needed platform that genuinely supports the indie spirit. Uploading and managing my game builds is straightforward.
review4.author: Priya Singh
